lina: Heads-up: post-RFC follow-up on pagination ergonomics. We're getting contradictory asks: some teams want "exactly-once" semantics across pages, others prefer throughput. I propose we codify two official modes: conservative (atomic pages, minimal retries) and aggressive (resume on token + best-effort item dedupe).

derek: Will these be SDK-level config flags?

lina: Yes: client.pagination.mode = 'conservative' | 'aggressive'. Default conservative. Conservative means pages are atomic and only transport-level retries for network glitches. Aggressive enables SDK resume logic and optional per-item dedupe hints when server supports it.

mich: How do we express dedupe hints? Server can set item_ids or stable keys. SDK will expose a dedupe callback or default hashing on item_id.

zane: Transport choices: don't bake gRPC-only features into default API. We'll keep a Transport interface: unaryFetch(req, opts) and streamFetch(req, opts) optional. TS/Python default to HTTP/JSON; Go can enable gRPC stream for better perf. All transports must emit consistent metrics.

lina: For retries, we should centralize a RetryBudget implementation used by StreamPages and other helpers. Budget configurable per-client and per-route. If budget exhausted, StreamPages returns a RetryBudgetExhausted error and stops.

derek: npm/py package upgrades: how long for deprecation? 6 months?

lina: 6 months for public deprecation, 3 months minimum overlap for shims. We'll run migration telemetry to see top callers.

mich: Examples requested. For TS ergonomic design: provide both client.streamPages(req) -> AsyncIterable and client.fetchPage(req, {idempotent:true}) -> Promise. For Python show both generator + async generator. Go: FetchPage(ctx, req, opts...) and StreamPages(ctx, req) chan Page.

zane: One more: partial page parsing failures should be surfaced as specific errors (PageParseError) including raw page payload in debug mode. Default behavior: fail whole page.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: Follow-up RFC draft #4301 created with pagination.mode and retry-budget. CI: run unit tests across SDKs.

lina: I'll assemble language snippets and a migration checklist. Posting in RFC PR by EOD. Thanks!
